source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag ACU Top-Load Dryer Technical Manual (WED5100/WGD5100)
source.oemTestTitle: Drum Light Incandescent Bulb or LED

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Console drum light button
steps.body: Press DRUM LIGHT on console — verify on/off toggles drum light.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press DRUM LIGHT on console — verify on/off toggles drum light.

steps.title: Access ACU
steps.body: Unplug dryer. Remove top panel. Verify J8-5 (incandescent) or J6 pins 1-2 (LED) seated.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug dryer. Remove top panel. Verify J8-5 (incandescent) or J6 pins 1-2 (LED) seated.

steps.title: Incandescent bulb path
steps.body: Unplug J8 and J9. Measure J8-5 to J9-2. Open → replace bulb.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug J8 and J9. Measure J8-5 to J9-2. Open → replace bulb.

steps.title: LED drum light — driver current
steps.body: Unplug J6 from HMI. Milliamps across J6 pins 1 and 3 with power on and drum light button on. Spec 150–370 mA.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug J6 from HMI. Milliamps across J6 pins 1 and 3 with power on and drum light button on. Spec 150–370 mA.

steps.title: Replace HMI or LED
steps.oemOutcome: No driver current — replace HMI; current present — replace drum LED.

steps.title: Drum light verified
steps.oemOutcome: Drum light responds to console and electrical path OK.
